items.title: Dick Griffin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 12, 2024
items.q: Esther Phillips is mentioned only as the artist for whom arrangements were written ('Body Talk... Esther Phillips'), with no direct interaction described between Dick Griffin and Esther Phillips.

ctx.x: I bet he got more than $75.

Oh yes. Let me tell you this one, this is a real good one and it’s an honest one. Okay Pee Wee Ellis and I were very good. I was ghost writing for Pee Wee Ellis. So when Pee Wee Ellis would get an arrangement assignment, he lived on Longfellow Avenue in the Bronx. He would call me up. And I didn’t sleep a lot at night. I mean whatever. I slept — I could go two hours sleep for days or nights. So Pee would call me up and it’d be like late at night, so I would go up and he would have these arrangements. “Body Talk”…
That is a behind-the-scenes story for sure. © Fillius Jazz Archive -22-
